properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the Shop sample's four-to-five change reached only two calcs, and no model element or drawing, because the two requirements accepted on 2026-10-24 that say exactly this (a changed quantity names every kept computation that used it; a changed part returns its redo list) have no capability and were never built or queued, and because the household size is prose that the calc copied
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-25, after Shop session 4, on integrated-flo 83d2b0775fe79af6:req:a-changed-requirement-flows-through-the-math-the-model-and-the-drawings.
① OBSERVED by session 4 (Shop sample 671a764fa790c030): after the household changed from four to five, loop_status showed 0 stale and 0 drift. propagate_from reached the growing-areas inference (distance 1) and the water calc (distance 3, as a risk crossing) only. The designer found the electricity, sand-filter and cistern effects, the model edits (one more solar module, a freezer) and the redraws itself.
② PRECEDENT, which reframes it: reflow2:dec:idea-reflow2-becomes-the-web-of-rules-for-a-buildings-ifc-model (accepted 2026-10-24) produced two accepted requirements:
- reflow2:req:a-changed-quantity-names-every-kept-computation-that-used-it;
- reflow2:req:a-change-to-a-physical-designs-part-returns-its-redo-list-by-trade ("every part, calculation, trade and drawing that depends on it").
Its third (a limit a measurement breaks) WAS built, in reflow2 #795. The integrated-flo requirement recorded today restates the first two without having searched first.
③-⑤ CANDIDATES, each with the measurement that could refute it:
(C1) the accepted intent was never built. Refuted if either requirement has a capability. MEASURED: propagate_from at depth 1 on each shows no SATISFIES, only its governing decision and its parent (design-anything). Neither was in the coordinator's queue after 2026-10-24 (plan-2026-10-25-queue), which took only #795's limit. SURVIVES as the main cause.
(C2) the household size is prose, not a quantity a computation can name. MEASURED: phase-c-growing-area-and-fish-stock.calc.json input `persons` has source {design_node: req:shop-grows-food-in-an-aquaponics-and-grow-loop} and its own copied value "4". The requirement's text holds the number. SURVIVES: the first requirement presumes "design quantities", which this design has none of for household size.
(C3) reflow2 cannot see which computation used which input, because a calc record is a file reflow2 does not read. MEASURED in part: the inputs' `source` exists only inside the JSON, and the design holds only `documents` from the record's artifact to a decision. SURVIVES as part of what C1's build must carry.
(C4, outside reflow2) the designer did not use propagation. REFUTED: session 4 used propagate_from and propagate_change, and they found what they could.
(C5) nothing marks a model element or a drawing stale. MEASURED earlier (fact:how-far-a-changed-requirement-flows-today-2026-10-25): elements carry the part they realize, and drawings their model sha, but nothing compares them. That is what the redo-list requirement asks.
⑥ CLASS: an accepted requirement with no capability does not drive work unless something schedules it. This is the third time on 2026-10-25 that a coordinator's plan, not reflow2's own loop, decided the work order: phase plans, the queue, and now this. It is the C3 cause of reflow2:fact:root-cause-a-design-does-not-drive-itself-to-complete-2026-10-25 again. The unsatisfied requirements sat among reflow2's 373 unsurfaced gaps. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
